args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE genuinely transparent square animation key-pose sheet, exactly TWO columns by TWO rows. Four equal cells with generous empty transparent gutters. No labels, grid, text, scenery, ground shadow, trails or detached particles.
Input1 is original anatomy/design authority; input2 is original face, paper construction and color authority. Draw the SAME recognizable Victamin in every cell: a limbless cheerleader paper-pompom bunny with exactly TWO complete long cream oval ears, orange inner ear on viewer-left and yellow on viewer-right; broad overlapping cream-white rectangular paper strips, sparse butter-yellow/apricot accents, orange square cheeks, tiny dark brown facial features. No arms, hands, legs, feet, fur, clothes or hat. Warm clean matte cel illustration with crisp taupe contours and broad readable seams, matching a polished small website mascot.
Four NEW coherent temporal keys for being tossed through the air. Entire ears and body remain inside each cell. Keep the body's apparent width and anchor consistent; transparent margin on every side. Show BOTH attached ears clearly, even while flexing. Paper body stays connected, never sheds scraps. Emotions are startled and bracing, never joyful grinning or happy eye-smiles.
Reading left-to-right, then top-to-bottom:
1. Launch surprise: broad body slightly pulled upward, ears flex backward, small round startled eyes and tiny open O mouth.
2. Rising flutter: body lengthens a little in the flight direction, attached paper layers fan backward; tense narrow eyes, tiny wavy closed mouth. Ears stream and curve with acceleration.
3. Floating at the apex: compact rounder paper body, both ears float apart while fully attached, small wide alert eyes and tiny neutral O mouth; suspended, not standing.
4. Braced descent: slightly vertically stretched body, paper layers and both ears trail upward, squeezed worried eyes and a small wavy closed mouth; anticipating landing. No tears or smiling mouth.
Near-front readable faces, modest coherent tilt. No motion blur, ghosting, duplicate outlines, glow, stippling or fuzzy micro-lines. Genuine transparent alpha throughout background and gutters. Four hand-drawn whole-mascot keys, not a sprite copied or rotated four times.
